prior_executor.result: No analysis result, modified files, commit or tests. Execution limitation, not evidence of source impossibility.

method: Fresh bounded static caller/prologue/normal-epilogue decode. Existing RTTI clue not promoted or repeatedly scanned.

observations.claim: On same caller-local S=ESI snapshot with BYTE[S+C0]!=0, LEA ECX=S+50; LEA EDX=S+A0; relative CALL targets 4149E790. No argument PUSH is present between this gate and call.

Callee pushes EBP/EBX/EDI/ESI then EAX scratch, reads [ECX] pointer and increments its DWORD, reads [ECX+4] accumulator pointer then BYTE[accumulator+7]; reads DWORD[EDX+1C]. Thus this caller supplies context address and point address in ECX/EDX.

Normal epilogue ADD ESP,4 discards scratch, POP ESI/EDI/EBX/EBP then bare RET; no RET immediate argument cleanup. Conditional on balanced normal CFG and intact stack, caller nonvolatile registers restored.
After return caller reads [ESI+30], [ESI+34], [ESI+1A0] and overwrites EAX. This window does not consume a typed return value; not proof all callers ignore return.

not_inferred: A named source declaration such as __fastcall, thiscall or a C++ class from ECX/EDX alone.
Identity of caller S with callback owner: [S+54] and its pointee chain are not flattened by equal offsets.
Stack arguments elsewhere, exceptional/index handler behavior, reachability, caller-context construction/lifetime or all callers.
RTTI ownership of callback, a single source language/toolchain/standard, or ABI of other boundaries.
